ms.report:
We successfully over-delivered the first and second milestones by 362%+ of tickets to the community based only on the funding we received from the initial distribution. The evidence shows we have made significant progress toward the project's goal of getting Cardano community conference tickets. We are about 73.8% way there and have completed 31 of 42 important tasks, events, and conferences. There are also 7 important tasks and conferences currently in progress. However, we are currently waiting for funding distribution to sponsor more tickets for the community and progress toward the third milestone for this project.

Please see Milestones 1 and 2 Proof of Achievements and Monthly Progress Report details: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nFi9Q1odOtKpmU0OF1TEI1AddOXtdBcDeuejdTt8h98/
